construction: Equal-weighted, point-in-time dated membership, buy-and-hold between changes. Members are 同花顺 (Tonghuashun) concept-board constituents, filtered to the free china_search price cache. Benchmark = CSI 300 (沪深300).
history_note: Membership is THS's, snapshotted over time; `added`/`removed` reflect when a name entered/left the THS board (first-run members seed at the cache start). Series before a name's add date is a backtest of the membership at that point.
note: A-share baskets mirroring 同花顺 concept-board themes & members — descriptive structure, not an out-of-sample backtest and not a buy list.
